### 🔵 Needs a closer look

A newly added bench-only allocator window (`bench/overlay-count/src/counting.rs`) has an incorrect `ACTIVE` state transition that can allow overlapping measurement windows.

<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

### Suppressed comments (1)

**Previously missed (1)** — in code that hasn't changed since the last review.

**bench/overlay-count/src/counting.rs:89**
* `begin()` uses `ACTIVE.swap(false, …)` which (a) clears the active flag before checking it (side effect on failure) and (b) doesn’t actually prevent a second concurrent `begin()` from entering between the swap and the later `ACTIVE.store(true, …)`. Even though this is a bench-only harness, it makes the allocator-window state machine incorrect and can undercount/overlap measurement windows.

</details>
